title: The Confession of the Fens
author: Coral Lockridge
blurb: Bram Reyes, an insurance investigator with a photographic memory, has spent twelve years keeping the town's secrets filed and alphabetized. But when the missing person's diary continues past the date she disappeared, she discovers that staying invisible was never really an option. To get through this, she must decode a ledger hidden in plain sight before the statute expires.
style: crisp modern voice, short chapters, propulsive momentum
